name: Qingren Lei
source:
The female demon leader Lin Xi was knocked off a cliff by Lu Yi, a disciple of the right path, but when she woke up, she found that she was in love, and as long as she was far away from Lu Yi, she would suffer heart-eating pain and was forced to tie up with him. Whether to fight, to flee, or to be forced to submit, all choices will be up to you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244420/]Steam[/url]]
